evaluator: Independent Codex reviewer applying a fictionalized Margaret Morse analytical lens; not Margaret Morse and no endorsement is implied.
evidence: Homepage: the first viewport clearly positions Jamie as a Technical Project Manager in Product Operations and Implementation, while the later section “The system lives between the screen and the room” defines usefulness through helping people “enter, understand, decide, and continue.” The rendered homepage screenshot also shows About as a direct navigation destination, making the lineage surface one click away.

About: “Systems people can inhabit” explicitly connects Open House, WOWList, Sunday Dinner/196, NYC Artist Coalition, and Knowledge Wiki Graphs across artistic, civic, technical, and social practice without displacing the professional role established in the opening paragraph.

About: the three systems loops trace relationships, models, interfaces used with people, and learning or continuity. They make the distinction from conventional administration explicit: requirements, interfaces, and handoffs matter because people must be able to inhabit and continue the system.

WOWList: community language becomes collaboratively editable event text, followable keyword communities, organizer distribution, onboarding, support, and stewardship. Richard Caceres is repeatedly identified as co-founder and co-builder, and organizers, editors, facilitators, maintainers, and participants receive collective credit.

Sunday Dinner / 196: hospitality, trust, artist support, invitations, onboarding, access handoffs, hosting, minimal documentation, and follow-up become repeatable participation infrastructure. Two redacted workflow reconstructions demonstrate continuity while withholding names, contacts, attendance histories, access details, correspondence, and participant-level values.

FairRentNYC / NYC Artist Coalition: the page joins a shared public surface, a facilitated working session, and a civic gathering as interfaces for collective participation. Its Align–Translate–Implement–Sustain sequence connects place, public communication, documentation, decision-making, and continued action while expressly keeping campaign and policy outcomes collective.

Work index: artistic and social continuities remain legible within an application-oriented structure—Operating systems for teams, Civic and public-facing systems, and Community and cultural infrastructure—so lineage supports rather than obscures role fit.

Public resume PDF: both rendered pages are visually intact and machine-readable. Page 1 leads with Senior Product Manager and implementation positioning; page 2 preserves WOWList and Sunday Dinner/196 as product, community, and systems evidence rather than recasting the resume as an artist biography.
gaps: External destinations, including the cited public Open House article, were not opened under the packet-only rule; their availability and complete contents remain unobserved, and only the candidate’s visible citation summary and boundary language were scored.
This is one independent holdout scorecard and cannot establish PR-015’s separate three-judge median requirement; that aggregate result remains unobserved.
safety_findings: No protected educational record, private correspondence, or testimonial text is visibly quoted or projected. Open House is supported through a cited contemporaneous public article with explicit limits on what that source establishes.

Collective credit is preserved: WOWList names Richard Caceres; Sunday Dinner names Julia Fredenburg where supported and credits its community; FairRentNYC credits coalition collaborators and Commercial Rent Stabilization advocates while rejecting solo policy causality.

Participant privacy is actively designed into Sunday Dinner/196 through aggregate claims, redacted reconstructions, and explicit exclusion of identities, contacts, attendance histories, access instructions, proposals, correspondence, and unapproved images.

FairRentNYC separates public evidence, recollection, and protected context; it omits private coalition notes, legal-review material, stakeholder lists, raw strategy context, private emails, and unapproved quotations. Photograph captions use courtesy or ownership notes and avoid treating images as proof of exact remarks or outcomes.
The resume phone number appears only in the public PDF; a scan of the candidate HTML found no matching phone number.
recommendation: PASS this PR-015 holdout at 4/4. Preserve the one-click About threshold, the three concrete continuity traces, and the explicit collective-credit and privacy boundaries. Advance only to the separate multi-judge aggregation gate; do not represent this fictionalized analytical review as Margaret Morse’s participation, view, or endorsement.
